planned_code_rules: Existing body tracks remain tracking-only candidates during bounded owner face loss.
Body acquisition/bootstrap remains restricted to live face evidence.
Body retirement is driven by body missThreshold instead of immediate face absence.
Initialized hand slots can track against internal DRIVER body evidence when output is not publishable.
Uninitialized hand slots cannot bootstrap from internal-only owners.
Every initialized hand slot advances hit or at most one miss per frame.
